full_judgment: 10. The learned Counsel for the petitioners has placed before us the case of Bangladesh Biman Corporation Vs. Rabia Bashri Irene and others reported in 44 DLR(AD) 132 and the case of Managing Director, Rupali Bank Limited and others Vs. Chairman, First Labour Court and others reported in 46 DLR(AD) 143. In our view, the facts of these cases are distinguishable from the facts of the present case and those have no manner of application in the present case.
